evidence: 0091 (D18, owner decisions D18-1 to D18-15 of 2026-10-27, every recommended default) lets the receiving laboratory or pharmacy end an order it accepted and cannot complete ("We can't complete this order"); item 3's report (C25), D17's late correction (C29) and lookup (C30), H6 and H7 are unchanged byte for byte and pinned. ehr.cannot_complete_order_route (owner-only), through lab.cannot_complete_order_route and pharmacy.cannot_complete_order_route (SECURITY DEFINER), is bound to the live direct-care staff session and the kind's receive permission; it refuses a transaction that is not READ COMMITTED before it reads anything (25000 ORDER_ROUTE_CANNOT_COMPLETE_READ_COMMITTED_REQUIRED); it ends only an accepted order still open for writing (never accepted ORDER_ROUTE_NOT_ACCEPTED; ended any way, reported, or lapsed ORDER_ROUTE_ALREADY_ENDED; completed ORDER_ROUTE_ALREADY_RETURNED), the state before the version (412 only while the order stays open); on a lab request it refuses while a checked (verified, not invalidated) result waits to be released (ORDER_ROUTE_RESULT_READY, D18-15) and, when a current, not invalidated version is flagged critical_candidate, unless B states it has phoned the ordering facility (ORDER_ROUTE_CRITICAL_VALUE_NOT_TOLD); one of 9 laboratory or 8 pharmacy reason codes (D18-5), no free text; at most 20 endings per member and 50 per facility in any 24 hours, never lifted (D18-7), exact under a transaction advisory lock per receiving facility (ORDER_ROUTE_CANNOT_COMPLETE_LIMIT, DETAIL the time another is possible; measured with two concurrent sessions at 49 and at 19: exactly 50 and 20 committed, a retry of the 20th replayed, and a second session REPEATABLE READ or SERIALIZABLE refused 25000 without waiting). Preconditions pin the replaced summary and 85 relied-upon bodies (md5 of pg_proc.prosrc measured on 0001-0090), the route's ended-kind, end and acceptance CHECKs and the route events' four CHECKs (compared with the same objects built in the session), T8's CHECKs, keys, columns and indexes as 0090 left them, the triggers, no object of 0091's names, that the closer's owner o, which owns every new object, holds every privilege the new bodies need, and that the applying role may act as every owner it acts for, counted by ownership, membership or grant and never through a superuser's bypass (121 refusing cases measured, each stopping with nothing applied; the negative copies: owners split by 0087-0090 applied as postgres stop already in 0090, a summary owned by a role the applier does not inherit stops in section 0, and on a copy whose C3 belongs to another role a section 5 without its read grant stops in its post-check); one NOTICE names every owner checked and another the CHECKs' form, which the migration runner prints in the release's log, and 0091's header gives the read-only query that lists the same owners and the route table's size on production before signing.
